arxiv-1712-06144.title: Search for the \cmsSymbolFace ​ X ​ ( 5568 ) \cmsSymbolFace{X}(5568) state decaying into \PBzs ​ \Pgppm \PBzs\Pgppm in proton-proton collisions at s = 8 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=8\TeV
arxiv-1712-06144.description: Abstract A search for resonance-like structures in the \PBzs ​ \Pgppm \PBzs\Pgppm invariant mass spectrum is performed using proton-proton collision data collected by the CMS experiment at the LHC at s = 8 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=8\TeV , corresponding to an integrated luminosity of 19.7 \fbinv .

arxiv-2203-04108.title: Comfortable place for quantum walkers on finite path
arxiv-2203-04108.creator: Yoshihiro Anahara, Norio Konno, Hisashi Morioka, Etsuo Segawa
arxiv-2203-04108.description: Abstract Abstract . We consider the stationary state of a quantum walk on the finite path, where the sink and source are set at the left and right boundaries. The quantum coin is uniformly placed at every vertex of the path graph.

arxiv-2209-06975.title: Wasserstein K K -means for clustering probability distributions
arxiv-2209-06975.creator: Yubo Zhuang, Xiaohui Chen, Yun Yang
arxiv-2209-06975.description: Abstract Clustering is an important exploratory data analysis technique to group objects based on their similarity. The widely used K K -means clustering method relies on some notion of distance to partition data into a fewer number of groups. In the Euclidean space, centroid-based and distance-based formulations of the K K -means are equivalent.

arxiv-2512-20402.title: iblock: Accurate and Scalable Bitcoin Simulations with OMNeT++ Conference: ; ;
arxiv-2512-20402.creator: Niccolò Scatena, Pericle Perazzo, Giovanni Nardini
arxiv-2512-20402.description: Abstract . This paper proposes iblock, a comprehensive C++ library for Bitcoin simulation, designed for OMNeT++. iblock offers superior efficiency and scalability with respect to state-of-the-art simulators, which are typically written in high-level languages. Moreover, the possible integration with other OMNeT++ libraries allows highly detailed simulations.

olaus-magnus-compendious-history-streate.title: Olaus Magnus: A Compendious History of the Goths, Swedes, and Vandals
olaus-magnus-compendious-history-streate.creator: Olaus Magnus
olaus-magnus-compendious-history-streate.description: The 1658 English abridgment of Olaus Magnus's 1555 Historia de gentibus septentrionalibus — sea monsters, mermen, and northern marvels.

pmc-11398636.title: Accumulation of production capital and income growth of Chinese farmers in the post-poverty alleviation era: A study based on a two-way fixed effects model with CFPS data
pmc-11398636.creator: Zhao Liu
pmc-11398636.description: Agricultural mechanization is a crucial indicator of modernization in agriculture. It improves productivity and underpins the evolution of a modern state. This study scrutinizes the enduring effects of government subsidies on farm machinery acquisition, income growth, and capital accumulation in rural households. It is based on policies about targeted poverty alleviation and rural revitalization.

pmc-11399464.title: Pharmacokinetic characteristics of mesenchymal stem cells in translational challenges
pmc-11399464.creator: Yunlong Shan, Mengying Zhang, Enxiang Tao, Jing Wang, Ning Wei, Yi Lu, Qing Liu, Kun Hao, Fang Zhou, Guangji Wang
pmc-11399464.description: Over the past two decades, mesenchymal stem/stromal cell (MSC) therapy has made substantial strides, transitioning from experimental clinical applications to commercial products. MSC therapies hold considerable promise for treating refractory and critical conditions such as acute graft-versus-host disease, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, and acute respiratory distress syndrome.

pmc-11593334.title: Exploring Youths’ Offers to Use E-Cigarettes in Rural Hawai‘i: A Test Development and Validation Study
pmc-11593334.creator: Scott K. Okamoto, Andrew M. Subica, Kelsie H. Okamura, Katlyn J. An, Sarah D. Song, Paula Angela Saladino, Adabelle B. Carson, Zarek K. Kon, Sarah Momilani Marshall, Steven Keone Chin, Joseph Keawe‘aimoku Kaholokula, Ian Pagano, Pallav Pokhrel
pmc-11593334.description: The purpose of this study is to describe the development and initial validation of a survey focused on problematic situations involving e-cigarette use by rural Native Hawaiian and Pacific Islander (NHPI) youths. A 5-phase approach to test development and validation was used.

pmc-11621411.title: Exploring the role of bridging nodes linking adverse childhood experiences and psychological risk factors in suicidal ideation among MSM
pmc-11621411.creator: Huifang Xu, Lulu Xu, Zuxin Wang, Chen Xu, Fan Hu, Yong Cai, Ying Wang
pmc-11621411.description: This study investigates the interplay between distal adverse childhood experiences (ACEs) and proximal psychological risk factors in predicting suicidal ideation among men who have sex with men (MSM) using network analysis. A total of 1138 MSM completed self-reported questionnaires on demographics, ACEs, depression, anxiety, interpersonal needs, and suicidal ideation.

pmc-12442422.title: The relationship between social support and mental health in athletes: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12442422.creator: Jianing Luo, Rui Du, Xiaolin Wang, Liang Luo
pmc-12442422.description: IntroductionSocial support is widely recognized as a key determinant of athletes’ mental health; however, inconsistencies remain regarding the strength and source-specific effects of this relationship. This meta-analysis systematically quantifies the association between social support and mental health outcomes in athletes and examines variations by support source.MethodsA systematic search was conducted across multiple databases to identify relevant studies.

pmc-13453605.title: Comparative Efficacy of Interventions for Burnout in Physician Residents: A Systematic Review and Network Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
pmc-13453605.creator: Yukiyoshi Sumi, Kenshiro Tabata, Yosuke Hatakeyama, Toshio Morizane, Hatoko Sasaki, Fujimi Kawai, Noriko Kojimahara
pmc-13453605.description: Background:Burnout during residency is common and is associated with adverse outcomes for clinicians and patients; however, the comparative efficacy of intervention approaches remains unclear. We aimed to compare the efficacy of different categories of interventions aimed at reducing burnout among physician residents.

pmc-13526066.title: Measurement properties of a patient-reported outcome scale for peptic ulcer: a validation study using classical test theory and generalizability theory
pmc-13526066.creator: Fang Xu, Na Luo, TianLe Fu, Yanxiang Gao, Qiaoyun Huang, Zaixue Mu, Xiran Xia, Jing Yang, Ying Chen
pmc-13526066.description: PurposeTo evaluate the measurement properties of the Patient-Reported Outcome Scale for Peptic Ulcer (PROISCD-PU) and to examine its reliability, validity, responsiveness, and domain-level measurement precision using an integrated framework of Classical Test Theory (CTT) and Generalizability Theory (GT).MethodsA total of 300 patients with peptic ulcer were recruited from tertiary hospitals and completed the PROISCD-PU.

pmc-13589366.title: Public awareness and acceptance of xenotransplantation in China: a cross-sectional survey
pmc-13589366.creator: Jing Wen, Haoran Li, Di Wang, Mingtao Huang, Xiaomei Zhai
pmc-13589366.description: BackgroundXenotransplantation using genetically edited pig organs has been considered a promising solution to the global organ shortage. However, its successful implementation depends not only on scientific advance but also on public acceptance. Empirical evidence on public awareness, acceptance, and ethical concerns regarding xenotransplantation in China remains scarce.
